This project combined Gushi readings/meanings with levels extracted from the official HSK syllabus and preserved homograph and additional-usage records.

derivation.wordGrouping: Grouped by simplified word form; removed official printed homograph-number suffixes from wordRaw for grouping only, retaining one record per official serial.
derivation.bandPolicy: Official primary bands 1–6 and the shared 7–9 band only. Gushi learning subdivisions 7/8/9 are not used as official levels.
derivation.usageBands: Only parenthesized additional usage bands from the official level cell; excludes the primary band. Empty when no parenthesized band is printed.
derivation.auxiliaryFields: Unique nonempty Gushi readings and English meanings for the same word form; arrays are unaligned and do not establish a one-to-one relation to official records, part of speech or sense.
limitations: Word-form lookup does not perform sense, pronunciation or part-of-speech disambiguation.
A highest-band policy over main and additional bands is conservative teaching support, not proof that the current usage belongs to that band.
No whole-sentence grammar certification, HSK exam-version advice or corpus-evidence status is provided.
